verification.gmail: Short-circuited. Every lead failed an irreversible public, registry, Semrush, exact-page, trust, or category gate before finalist status, so no Gmail-clean claim is made for rejected roots.
verification.external_actions: No email, form, issue, pull request, account creation, CAPTCHA, subscription, or deployment was performed.

limitations: Semrush Authority Score, organic traffic, Page AS, and network labels are third-party signals rather than Google ranking metrics.
The Semrush API could not execute reports because the account had insufficient API units; the logged-in browser UI was used read-only instead.
Several exact Page AS values were unavailable. Missing values were not inferred from root-domain authority.
A Semrush 404 or 522 label was never accepted as final broken-link evidence when a fresh live check resolved normally or the state was transient.

Process deviation: the approved sequence was registry, Gmail Sent/Drafts/Scheduled, Semrush, and live-page verification for every lead. Gmail was short-circuited only after an irreversible registry, public-page, exact-page, trust, or category veto; no rejected lead is claimed Gmail-clean, and no finalist depended on the skipped gate.
The future benchmark target must not be proposed anywhere until its 2026-09-10 indexable deployment and live canonical/download verification.
